Third-party libraries, served from this site (also on its mirrors) instead of a CDN.
Byte-identical to the npm releases; index.html and js/player.mjs check them with SRI hashes.

globe.gl-2.46.2.min.js   globe.gl 2.46.2, MIT (LICENSE-globe.gl.txt), https://github.com/vasturiano/globe.gl
                         The bundle includes three.js (MIT) and other MIT/ISC modules, credited in their packages.
hls.light-1.5.17.min.js  hls.js 1.5.17 light build, Apache 2.0 (LICENSE-hls.js.txt), https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js
